attributes.storage_instructions: Store in a cool, dry place, away from direct sunlight and heat. No refrigeration needed—our ghee stays fresh at room temperature. Always use a clean, dry spoon to avoid contamination. Ensure the lid is tightly closed after each use to maintain aroma and purity. Over time, natural granulation or slight changes in colour may occur—this is normal and a sign of authentic, traditionally made ghee.
